note: Bluff-top campground strung for a kilometre along the ocean side of Coast Highway 101 in Cardiff-by-the-Sea, 13-17 m above a narrow beach reached by stairways; a nearby reef draws snorkelers and divers. Premium sites line the bluff edge. The full-hookup sites, all in the middle section, are short (about 24 ft); non-hookup sites take rigs to 35 ft. Camp store and restaurant on site; dogs are allowed in the campground but not on the beach. --Claude
